query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deploy_requests (id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, client_id UUID, project_name TEXT NOT NULL, project_files JSONB, target_platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_platform IN ('cloudflare', 'vercel', 'netlify')), status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'deployed')), deployed_url TEXT, admin_notes TEXT, processed_by UUID, processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW())
